sentences.en: And so I took a few shots from Bob, but Dylan got in a fight with the then head trainer and fired him.
sentences.zh: 所以我挨了鲍勃几拳，后来迪伦和当时的首席教练吵了一架，把他解雇了。

sentences.en: And Gary Shandling, who's a good friend of mine, was also training at that gym.
sentences.zh: 加里·山德林，我的好朋友，当时也在那家健身房训练。

sentences.en: And Gary came to me and said, Pete, why don't we take this trainer and start our own gym?
sentences.zh: 加里来找我说：皮特，我们为什么不把这个教练挖过来，自己开一家健身房呢？

sentences.en: And I said, okay, seemed like a better, more interesting experience than opening a bar.
sentences.zh: 我说好啊，这看起来比开酒吧更有趣、体验更好。

sentences.en: And so Gary and I backed this gentleman, started our own gym, and the gentleman who we hired ended up leaving.
sentences.zh: 于是加里和我资助了这位先生，开了我们自己的健身房，但我们雇的那位先生最后还是走了。

sentences.en: We had some problems with him.
sentences.zh: 我们和他之间出了一些问题。
后来加里去世了，愿他安息。

sentences.en: Gary Shandling, who I love so much, and left me alone with a boxing gym.
sentences.zh: 加里·山德林，我非常爱他，他却把我一个人留在了这家拳击馆里。

sentences.en: And it has been one of the stupidest things that I have ever done in my life, bar fucking none.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是我这辈子做过的最蠢的事情之一，没有之一。

sentences.en: That sounds like such an easy thing to run.
sentences.zh: 听起来经营起来很容易啊。

sentences.en: Low overhead, there's no maintenance, there's no.
sentences.zh: 运营成本低，不需要维护，不需要……

sentences.en: Hey, clean these towels and lock the door.
sentences.zh: 嘿，把这些毛巾洗干净，把门锁好。

sentences.en: Two things, actually, technically three things.
sentences.zh: 其实有两件事，严格来说是三件事。

sentences.en: One thing is people say that I got a lot of blind spots, but I don't see them.
sentences.zh: 第一件事是，人们总说我有很多盲点，但我自己看不见。

sentences.en: The other thing is this, Pete, is my son, who's 16, the last year and a half, he's gotten into boxing,
sentences.zh: 另一件事是这样的，皮特，我儿子今年16岁，过去一年半里，他迷上了拳击，

sentences.en: and he's boxing at another gym that I'm not going to name, but he's going twice.
sentences.zh: 他在另一家健身房练拳，我就不提名字了，但他每周去两次。

sentences.en: And now he just said to me last night, Dad, can I start going three times a week?
sentences.zh: 昨晚他刚跟我说：爸爸，我可以开始每周去三次吗？

sentences.en: And he boxes with this guy, which is really cool.
sentences.zh: 他跟着那个人练拳，真的很酷。

sentences.en: And I was thinking, like, I'd love to get him out to your gym, maybe, and get him in there and get another one.
sentences.zh: 我在想，也许我很乐意把他带到你的健身房去，让他去那里练，再多练一个。

sentences.en: Churchill Boxing Club in Santa Monica, come on down.
sentences.zh: 圣莫尼卡的丘吉尔拳击俱乐部，欢迎过来。

sentences.en: We're going to get a nice boon.
But here's what I wanted to say is a little sideline, because I do want to finish the boxing theme,
sentences.zh: 但我真正想说的是个小插曲，因为我确实想结束拳击这个话题，

sentences.en: is we haven't spent enough time, I feel like we've been delinquent on this podcast,
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们在播客里花的时间不够，有点失职，

sentences.en: we haven't spent enough time talking about and giving credence to Gary Shanley.
sentences.zh: 我们没有花足够的时间去谈论和认可加里·山德林。

sentences.en: Because he was one of, talk about a heavyweight, to use the analogy.
sentences.zh: 因为他绝对是——用拳击术语来说——重量级人物。

sentences.en: This guy was an unbelievable, he's the reason I got HBO.
sentences.zh: 这家伙简直不可思议，我能有HBO全靠他。

sentences.en: I didn't know the guy, but what an influence he had on what we consider to be comedy now, in a lot of ways.
sentences.zh: 我不认识他，但在很多方面，他对我们现在所理解的喜剧影响深远。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I got to see both sides of Gary.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我有幸见识了加里的两面。

sentences.en: I saw him as a comic titan and a very entrenched member of our industry.
sentences.zh: 我见过他作为喜剧泰斗的一面，也见过他作为我们行业里根深蒂固的一员的一面。

sentences.en: And that's how most people knew Gary.
sentences.zh: 这也是大多数人认识加里的方式。

sentences.en: The boxing gym is actually a fascinating culture.
sentences.zh: 拳击馆其实是一个很有意思的文化圈。

sentences.en: Our gym is meant to be a pretty traditional boxing gym with pro fighters.
sentences.zh: 我们的拳馆本意是做一家拥有职业拳手的传统拳击馆。

sentences.en: So we would have a lot of Russians, South Americans, we had folks from Japan, we had Chinese fighters.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有很多俄罗斯人、南美人，还有来自日本和中国的拳手。

sentences.en: And these were young men who would come to L.A., rarely spoke much English, were not at all connected.
sentences.zh: 这些年轻人来到洛杉矶，几乎不会说英语，也完全没有社会关系。

sentences.en: And Gary took a deep interest in their lives.
sentences.zh: 而加里对他们的生活表现出了浓厚的兴趣。

sentences.en: And I would come into the gym and Gary would be sitting with, you know,
sentences.zh: 我经常走进拳馆，看到加里坐在那儿，你知道，

sentences.en: a couple of kids from Argentina talking about boxing and talking about life and had this incredible connection.
sentences.zh: 和几个阿根廷小伙子聊拳击、聊生活，他们之间有着不可思议的联系。

sentences.en: And when Gary passed away, there was a huge memorial.
sentences.zh: 加里去世时，举办了一场盛大的追悼会。

sentences.en: I don't know if any of you guys went to it.
sentences.zh: 不知道你们有没有人去过。

sentences.en: You know, a couple thousand people.
You know, everyone in Hollywood went to Gary's memorial service.
sentences.zh: 好莱坞的所有人都去了加里的追悼会。

sentences.en: And then the next day, we had a service for him at the gym.
sentences.zh: 第二天，我们在拳馆也为他举办了一场仪式。

sentences.en: And there were, you know, a couple of hundred people who knew Gary only as G from the gym.
sentences.zh: 当时有几百人，他们只知道加里是拳馆里的“G”。

sentences.en: And they had no idea that he was, you know, famous.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不知道他很有名。

sentences.en: They had no idea that he had this other life.
sentences.zh: 他们完全不知道他还有另一面人生。

sentences.en: They just thought he was a really sweet guy who cared about them.
sentences.zh: 他们只觉得他是个真心关心他们的好人。

sentences.en: And so that was a side of Gary.

sentences.zh: 加里，他是真的热爱拳击。

sentences.en: He loved Bob Dylan and loved fighting with Bob Dylan.
sentences.zh: 他热爱鲍勃·迪伦，也喜欢和鲍勃·迪伦打架。

sentences.en: I'd love to see that pay-per-view.
sentences.zh: 我真想看看那场按次付费的直播。

sentences.en: Gary tried to do a talk show where he would fight you three rounds in the ring.
sentences.zh: 加里曾尝试做一档脱口秀，节目里他会和你在拳台上打三个回合。

sentences.en: And as soon as those three rounds were over, you would collapse.
sentences.zh: 等那三个回合一结束，你就会瘫倒在地。

sentences.en: He would do the interview after you'd been punching the shit out of each other.
sentences.zh: 在你们互相把对方揍得半死之后，他还要进行采访。

sentences.en: And he only did one with Alec Baldwin.
sentences.zh: 他只做了一期，嘉宾是亚历克·鲍德温。

sentences.en: And I was there for it.
And they both, I think, had heart attacks.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们俩当时都心脏病发作了。
字面意义上的轻微心脏病发作。

sentences.en: And at the end of the third round, Baldwin was laying on his side.
sentences.zh: 第三回合结束时，鲍德温侧躺在地上。

sentences.en: And Gary was laying on his stomach.
And Gary was trying to ask him questions.
sentences.zh: 加里还在努力问他问题。
你是怎么入行的，亚历克？

sentences.en: And Baldwin was just like, I think I really need some water.
sentences.zh: 而鲍德温只是说，我觉得我真的需要喝点水。

sentences.en: And I'm like, guys, you're both...
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，伙计们，你们俩……

sentences.en: And it got kind of real, too, when they were fighting, too.
sentences.zh: 而且他们打架的时候，场面还挺真实的。

sentences.en: No, they were beating the shit out of each other.
sentences.zh: 不，他们当时打得不可开交。

sentences.en: And Gary was deceptively effective as a boxer.
sentences.zh: 而加里作为拳击手，表现出的杀伤力出人意料。

sentences.en: And I think Alec didn't quite know what he was in for.
sentences.zh: 我觉得亚历克当时还没意识到自己要面对什么。

sentences.en: And Alec thought it was going to be kind of fun.
sentences.zh: 亚历克还以为这会挺好玩的。

sentences.en: And Shanley just started face punching him over and over and over.
sentences.zh: 结果尚利对着他的脸就是一顿猛揍，没完没了。
没错，场面变得诡异地真实起来。

sentences.en: Pete, you got to show us this.
sentences.zh: 皮特，你得给我们看看这个。

sentences.en: Gary shot it, so we could maybe dig it up.
sentences.zh: 是加里拍的，所以我们或许能把它找出来。

sentences.en: But I was literally concerned that they were both having heart attacks.
sentences.zh: 但我当时真的担心他们俩会心脏病发作。

sentences.en: And I got them to stop and drink water.
sentences.zh: 我让他们停下来喝点水。

sentences.en: And then, you know, it was one of those...
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，那就像是那种……

sentences.en: It was a deep level of exhaustion.
It's just like an icebreaker before an interview?
sentences.zh: 这就像是采访前的破冰环节吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, just to put everybody at ease.
sentences.zh: 对，只是为了让大家放松一下。

sentences.en: And we will be right back.
And now, back to the show.
Pete, I do want to go back, though.
sentences.zh: 皮特，我还是想回到刚才的话题。

sentences.en: I want to get back into how you became who you are, which is, as Jason said in the intro,
sentences.zh: 我想聊聊你是如何成为今天的你，正如杰森在开场白里说的，

sentences.en: I mean, you're an incredible filmmaker and actor.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你是一位了不起的电影制作人和演员。

sentences.en: And you haven't acted as much in the last few years as you used to.
sentences.zh: 而且你这几年演戏不像以前那么多了。

sentences.en: But you started as an actor.
sentences.zh: 但你是以演员身份出道的。

sentences.en: And Jason, you probably feel a lot of connection to what Pete does because he was able to kind of go from an actor who was in a lot of stuff.
sentences.zh: 杰森，你可能对皮特的经历很有共鸣，因为他成功地从一个参演过很多作品的演员，

sentences.en: And people wanted to become a director yourself, which I know is a trajectory that you're sort of on.
sentences.zh: 转型成了人们希望你成为的那种导演，我知道你现在也正走在这条路上。

sentences.en: Pete, talk a little bit about that, like about being an actor who's auditioning for jobs,
sentences.zh: 皮特，谈谈这个过程吧，比如作为一个到处试镜的演员，

sentences.en: then an actor who's in demand, and then turning that into or having the vision or having...
sentences.zh: 然后变成一个抢手的演员，再到后来有了转型的想法或愿景，或者拥有……

sentences.en: Talk about what it was that inspired you to become a director, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 谈谈是什么启发了你成为一名导演，等等。

sentences.en: So I think one of the lightbulb moments for me that got me really starting to think about directing,
sentences.zh: 我觉得对我来说，有一个让我开始认真考虑导演工作的顿悟时刻，

sentences.en: which was something I'd always thought about, and I think Jason always had to,
sentences.zh: 这事我一直都在想，我想杰森也一直有这个想法，

sentences.en: and it was something we used to talk about when we were working together.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们以前一起工作时常聊的话题。

sentences.en: I remember on the set of Hancock in particular, you talking about filmmaking and me kind of sensing that you were going to move in this direction.
sentences.zh: 我记得特别是在《全民超人汉考克》片场，你谈论电影制作时，我就感觉到你会往这个方向发展。

sentences.en: But for me, I was an actor on Chicago Hope, which was a pretty successful medical drama.
sentences.zh: 但对我而言，当时我正在演《芝加哥希望》，那是一部相当成功的医疗剧。

sentences.en: And we went up against ER every Thursday night at 10 o'clock, and they beat us every Thursday night.
sentences.zh: 我们每周四晚上十点都要和《急诊室的故事》正面硬刚，结果每周四晚上我们都输给他们。

sentences.en: But we were still getting 23 million people watching us, which we thought was just horrible because we were coming in second.
sentences.zh: 但当时我们依然有2300万观众，我们觉得这简直糟透了，因为我们总是排在第二。

sentences.en: And that was horrible, but in looking back on it, obviously it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 那确实很糟糕，但回过头来看，显然并非如此。

sentences.en: But I was getting kind of famous as this doctor, Dr. Billy Cronk on Chicago Hope.
sentences.zh: 当时我因为《芝加哥希望》里的比利·克朗克医生这个角色变得小有名气。

sentences.en: And, you know, when you back then in particular got TV famous, you were pretty famous.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在那个年代，如果你在电视上出名了，那可是相当出名的。

sentences.en: So wherever I went, people were like, hey, Billy, how you doing, Billy?
sentences.zh: 所以无论我走到哪，人们都会说，嘿，比利，你好吗，比利？

sentences.en: How's Diane, my wife on the show?
sentences.zh: 戴安怎么样了，就是我在剧里的妻子？
还有，嘿，比利，那个……怎么样了？

sentences.en: And I'm like, okay, I'm not fucking Billy.
sentences.zh: 我就想，好吧，我他妈才不是比利。

sentences.en: And at a certain point, I started sensing that if I wasn't careful, my legacy was going to be Dr. Billy Cronk, the TV doctor.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，我开始意识到，如果我不小心点，我的职业生涯标签可能就成了“电视医生比利·克朗克”。

sentences.en: And I was on a plane flying from LA to JFK.
sentences.zh: 当时我正坐飞机从洛杉矶飞往肯尼迪机场。

sentences.en: And I was sitting in my seat, and people were walking by me.
sentences.zh: 当时我坐在座位上，人们从我身边走过。

sentences.en: And a man stopped, and he said, hey, Billy.
sentences.zh: 有个男人停下来，说，嘿，比利。

sentences.en: And I said, my name's not Billy.
He goes, hey, Billy, my wife has this rash.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，比利，我老婆长了疹子。

sentences.en: And she pulled up her shirt and stuck her elbow, which had a really bad rash on it, in my face.
sentences.zh: 她掀起衬衫，把长了严重皮疹的胳膊肘凑到我脸上。

sentences.en: And I'm just sitting there staring at this rash, and they're smiling at me.
sentences.zh: 我坐在那儿盯着这疹子，他们还冲我笑。

sentences.en: And other people on the plane are all kind of like, hey, Billy, what do you think the rash is?
sentences.zh: 飞机上其他人也都在说，嘿，比利，你觉得这疹子是什么？

sentences.en: And I started writing, and I wrote a movie, Very Bad Things, which was my first film.
sentences.zh: 于是我开始写作，写了一部电影《坏坏坏电影》，那是我的第一部作品。

sentences.en: And that was something that once I got a taste of that and figured out that I could do it, I never really looked back.
sentences.zh: 一旦尝到了甜头，发现自己能做到，我就再也没回过头。

sentences.en: And I do love acting, but I was not going to be Billy Cronk for the rest of my career.
sentences.zh: 我确实热爱表演，但我不想在余下的职业生涯里一直当比利·克朗克。

sentences.en: But what was that thing that made you, were you scared to be like, I can't believe I can, I'm going to try to do this.
sentences.zh: 但当时是什么让你下定决心？你有没有害怕过，比如，不敢相信自己能行，但还是想试一试。

sentences.en: Like, how did you get over the fear?
Because you had a real career as an actor.
sentences.zh: 因为你当时已经是一名真正的职业演员了。

sentences.en: Like, you got to make a leap a little bit and go like, all right, I'm going to do this.
sentences.zh: 你得冒点险，对自己说，好吧，我要干这个。

sentences.en: So I was flying to New York to act when the rash was-
sentences.zh: 当时我正飞往纽约去演戏，结果就遇到了疹子事件——

sentences.en: And the same guy was on the plane and said, I have a different rash.
sentences.zh: 同一个人又在飞机上说，我长了另一种疹子。

sentences.en: And the reason I was on that plane where I was presented with the rash was I was flying to New York to be in a movie called Copland.
sentences.zh: 我之所以在那架飞机上遇到疹子，是因为我当时正飞往纽约去参演一部叫《警察帝国》的电影。

sentences.en: I was going to act in it.
And that was Stallone and De Niro.
sentences.zh: 那是史泰龙和德尼罗主演的。

sentences.en: And Stallone had put weight on and was going to, you know, try and win an Oscar.
sentences.zh: 史泰龙当时增了重，想要冲击奥斯卡。

sentences.en: And this was Harvey Weinstein producing it in the height of his power.
sentences.zh: 那是哈维·韦恩斯坦权势最盛时期监制的电影。

sentences.en: And Ray Liot and Harvey Keitan, all these big stars were in the film.
sentences.zh: 雷·利奥塔、哈维·凯特尔，所有这些大明星都在片子里。

sentences.en: And I had a small part in it.

sentences.zh: 不，是詹姆斯·曼高德导演的。

sentences.en: And I was one of the cops.
And most of my scenes were in this, like, bar.
sentences.zh: 我大部分戏份都在一个酒吧里。

sentences.en: And I would just sit around waiting for my one line.
sentences.zh: 我就坐在那儿等着说我那句台词。

sentences.en: So Stallone would talk and De Niro would talk.
sentences.zh: 史泰龙会说，德尼罗也会说。

sentences.en: And then finally it would be my line.
sentences.zh: 最后终于轮到我的台词了。

sentences.en: And I'd be like, yeah, for sure.

sentences.zh: 听起来跟我拍《搏击王国》时一样。
顺便说一下，杰森，插一句。

sentences.en: Jason and I had one of my favorite lines ever delivered in the film.
sentences.zh: 杰森和我贡献了我在电影里最喜欢的台词之一。

sentences.en: And you know what it is.
It was like, hey, driver, are you late for something?
sentences.zh: 就是那句，嘿，司机，你赶时间吗？

sentences.en: You guys are cruising along the desert?
sentences.zh: 你们几个在沙漠里兜风？

sentences.en: But I was on the set of Copland just watching everything happen.
sentences.zh: 但我当时在《警察帝国》的片场，看着一切发生。

sentences.en: And there was this young director, James Mangold.
sentences.zh: 那里有一位年轻的导演，詹姆斯·曼高德。

sentences.en: And he was arguing with Stallone and getting into all this creative stuff with De Niro and Ray Leo.
sentences.zh: 他当时正和史泰龙争论，还和德尼罗以及雷·利奥塔探讨各种创意。

sentences.en: And it was just like he was alive.
sentences.zh: 他看起来就像是充满了生命力。

sentences.en: He had this energy coming out of him.
sentences.zh: 他身上散发着那种能量。

sentences.en: And I was sitting there waiting for my line.
sentences.zh: 我当时坐在那儿等我的台词。

sentences.en: And I finally, at lunch, I walked up to him.
sentences.zh: 最后在午餐时，我走过去找他。

sentences.en: I said, hey, man, can I ask you a question?
sentences.zh: 我说，嘿，伙计，我能问你个问题吗？

sentences.en: He said, I said, how do I get your job?
sentences.zh: 我说，我该怎么才能得到你的这份工作？

sentences.en: How do I get your job?
sentences.zh: 我该怎么才能得到你的这份工作？

sentences.en: You want to work 60 minutes an hour, not just 10.
sentences.zh: 你想每小时工作60分钟，而不是只工作10分钟。

sentences.en: And he said, you got to write.

sentences.en: He goes, well, do you know how to write?
He goes, well, do you have an idea?
sentences.zh: 他说，那你有什么想法吗？

sentences.zh: 他说，我通常的做法是使用索引卡片。

sentences.en: And so then when I get all my cards, then I've got the idea.
sentences.zh: 等我把所有的卡片都准备好，我就有了构思。

sentences.en: Then I start writing the scenes.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始写剧本场景。

sentences.en: And so I went back to my hotel.

sentences.zh: 我当时住在纽约的埃塞克斯大厦酒店。

sentences.en: It has the big, beautiful park views, right?
sentences.zh: 那里有漂亮的大公园景观，对吧？

sentences.zh: 我住的是酒店里最烂的房间。

sentences.en: I had the back, tiny little room in the back of the hotel
sentences.zh: 我住的是后面一个又小又破的房间，

sentences.en: that looked out over an alley.

sentences.zh: 我回到住处，去了趟药店。

sentences.en: And I started writing the note cards and outlining the script.
sentences.zh: 我开始写索引卡片，构思剧本大纲。

sentences.zh: 我每天去工作，回来后又写更多的卡片。

sentences.en: And I had this whole crazy system.
sentences.zh: 我当时有一套非常疯狂的系统。

sentences.zh: 有一天我回来，发现那些笔记卡片全都被挪动并整理过了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, who did this?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，这是谁干的？

我正在写一部电影剧本。

sentences.zh: 我告诉她，故事讲的是几个家伙去拉斯维加斯，不小心杀了一个妓女，

sentences.zh: 后来曼努埃拉帮我写剧本，因为我会把想法都跟她交流。

sentences.zh: 我把剧本贴满了整个房间。

sentences.zh: 所以我感觉自己就生活在故事里。

sentences.en: Walked me down into the park suite.

sentences.en: And they said, Manuela told us what you're doing.

我以前从不知道这些，皮特。

sentences.en: Well, Pete, how did you take your, you know, you're very, you've got a very, your taste,
sentences.zh: 那么，皮特，你是怎么形成你那种，你知道的，你非常有，你的品味，

sentences.zh: 你的感性，你的个性非常，你知道的，老练且不来虚的。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's no real artifice to you, which I just fucking love.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你身上没什么矫揉造作，我真是太喜欢这一点了。

sentences.en: And yet, and you've somehow managed to take that and mold it into an actual visual aesthetic, too.
sentences.zh: 然而，你却以某种方式将其塑造成了一种真正的视觉美学。

sentences.en: Like the style of your films, the way in which they're shot, the way in which they're cut,

sentences.zh: 你雇用的演员，你要求他们做和不做的事情。

sentences.en: Like where, how is that shaped?
sentences.zh: 这些是怎么塑造出来的？

sentences.en: I mean, the, the things that I think that I do that tend to work the best, like if it's Friday Night Lights
sentences.zh: 我是说，我觉得我做得最成功的事情，比如《胜利之光》

sentences.en: or The Kingdom or Deepwater Horizon or Patriot's Day, these are, these are films that I do a tremendous amount of research on.
sentences.zh: 或者《反恐王国》、《深海浩劫》还是《爱国者日》，这些都是我做了大量调研的电影。

sentences.en: You know, I'm kind of a psycho about that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在这方面我简直是个疯子。

sentences.zh: 昨晚我们遭遇了导弹袭击，场面相当震撼，但也有些吓人。

sentences.en: And I've always been someone who likes to see things for myself.
sentences.zh: 我一直是个喜欢亲眼见证事物的人。

sentences.en: And, and that generally translates to, to my writing.
sentences.zh: 这通常也体现在我的写作中。

sentences.en: And I try to, try to have, have this deep of a almost anthropological or almost journalistic understanding of my world.
sentences.zh: 我试图对我的世界有一种深刻的、近乎人类学或新闻学式的理解。

sentences.en: So, you know, I went to Saudi Arabia a long time ago before we did The Kingdom and, you know,

sentences.zh: 我在那里住了三周，尽可能多地去了解那种文化。

sentences.en: And once I, I kind of feel like I've done that work and I understand the world.
sentences.zh: 一旦我觉得我已经做了这些功课，理解了这个世界，

sentences.zh: 在拍《孤独的幸存者》时，我去了伊拉克，随海军海豹突击队在叙利亚边境待了一个月。

sentences.en: And, and that helped me make a better film.
sentences.zh: 这确实帮助我拍出了一部更好的电影。

sentences.en: And that, you know, helps me in theory communicate with, you know,
sentences.zh: 这在理论上也有助于我与人沟通，你知道，

sentences.en: someone, you know, like when we were doing the, the scene in The Kingdom where they, you know,
sentences.zh: 就像我们拍《王国》里那场戏的时候，他们，你知道，

sentences.en: we're going to cut your head off.
You know, I, I've had a, I've tried to have a proximity,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一直试图保持一种亲近感，

sentences.en: certainly never to that kind of level of violence, but to at least understand as best as I can,
sentences.zh: 当然从未达到那种暴力程度，但至少要尽可能地去理解，

sentences.en: you know, what these, you know, executions were looking like and, and how they might've gone down.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些处决看起来是什么样子的，以及它们可能是如何发生的。

sentences.en: And that I think could help me help you reach an appropriate level of terror and a willingness to fight,
sentences.zh: 我认为这能帮助我引导你达到一种恰当的恐惧感和求生欲，

sentences.en: which you did so well in that, which I found fascinating.
sentences.zh: 你在那场戏里表现得太棒了，我觉得非常迷人。

sentences.en: And I've had so many people talk about that scene and how Jason Bateman, this sweet, funny guy,
sentences.zh: 很多人跟我谈起过那场戏，谈到杰森·贝特曼这个可爱又风趣的家伙，

sentences.en: went fucking psycho to save himself.
sentences.zh: 为了自救变得多么疯狂。

sentences.en: And that really comes from the research.
sentences.zh: 这确实源于前期的调研。

sentences.en: So then you're looking for a level of authenticity that then just naturally lends itself to,
sentences.zh: 所以你在追求一种真实感，这种真实感自然而然地引向了，

sentences.en: let's say, a handheld camera, desaturated color, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 比如说，手持摄影、低饱和度色彩等等。

sentences.en: Like, so all of these things, you're, you're, you're engineering it from a very organic place.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些东西，你都是从一个非常有机的地方构建出来的。

sentences.en: You're not kind of going backwards into an aesthetic.
sentences.zh: 你不是在生搬硬套某种美学风格。

sentences.en: And, and, and, you know, when I was acting on Chicago Hope back in those days, I learned so much
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当我在那个年代出演《芝加哥希望》时，我学到了很多，

sentences.en: because we, you know, we were doing 28 episodes a season and we would have 28 different directors coming in.
sentences.zh: 因为我们一季要拍28集，会有28位不同的导演轮流执导。

sentences.en: And a lot of these directors were, um, you know, they tried to have feature careers and they were a bit older

sentences.zh: 他们很急躁，试图证明自己是昆汀或斯科塞斯。

sentences.zh: 他们会花大量时间布置机位，做各种繁琐的事情。

sentences.en: And we, as actors would sit around waiting for all this equipment.
sentences.zh: 而我们演员就坐在旁边等着这些设备调试好。

sentences.en: And I'm like, what the fuck are we doing here?
sentences.zh: 我当时就在想，我们到底在干什么？

sentences.en: I want to, I want to be, feel free to, to, to, you know, not be beholden to the, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想，我想，我希望能感到自由，不必受制于，你知道，

sentences.en: and you guys have all seen it, the machinery of filmmaking where cranes and dollies and lighting
sentences.zh: 你们都见过，电影制作的那套机械流程，摇臂、轨道、灯光，

sentences.zh: 所以彼得·伯格的风格，就是多机位，同时使用手持摄像机。

sentences.zh: 而另外两台摄像机还在继续拍摄。

sentences.en: And while we're resetting back to the top of the scene, like multiple takes over and over and over again
